mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notify_task (type, user_type, user_id, title, content, retry_count, status) VALUES (#{type}, #{userType}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, 0, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT id, type, user_type, user_id, title, content, retry_count, status, create_time, update_time FROM notify_task WHERE status = 0 AND retry_count < 3 ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE notify_task SET status = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE notify_task SET retry_count = retry_count + 1, status = IF(retry_count + 1 >= 3, 2, 0) WHERE id = #{id}
